system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 14:15 UTC, the domain controller recorded Kerberos authentication for dana.wells from 10.20.20.30 to the WS-KORTEGA-01$ service, followed by a successful network logon for dana.wells on WS-KORTEGA-01 from that same address.
The evidence identifies 10.20.20.30 as PROXY-LV-01: a record from that host shows it using 10.20.20.30 as its source address.

A successful logon to the IT administrator workstation from the proxy address is inconsistent with the stated practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-KORTEGA-01 inside the office, and warrants treating the authentication as suspicious.
At 13:40 UTC, WS-DWELLS-01 established a proxy tunnel to download.windowsupdate.com; the proxy logged 41.8 MB of server-to-client data and a Windows Update Agent user agent.
The Windows Update activity is consistent with patching, but the available records do not show that it caused the reported PowerShell window or explain the later authentication to WS-KORTEGA-01.
A Google Drive File Stream process was running on WS-DWELLS-01 and terminated at 14:19 UTC; the inventory does not list Google Drive as approved software or storage.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a process-creation event identifying PowerShell, its command line, parent process, or user around the reported 13:40 UTC time.
The records show the source address of the 14:15 authentication but do not establish whether the request originated on PROXY-LV-01 or was relayed through it.
The evidence provided is a selected set of records for the review window; it does not establish that all relevant endpoint, authentication, and network events are present.
claims_not_established: What caused the reported PowerShell window, whether PowerShell actually executed, or what commands it ran.
Who initiated the authentication to WS-KORTEGA-01, whether dana.wells's credentials were compromised, or whether the activity was authorized.
Whether the Google Drive process was used to transfer data or was related to the reported PowerShell activity.
Whether the Windows Update download was part of the scheduled patching activity or was initiated by another process.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect process-creation and PowerShell operational/script-block logs from WS-DWELLS-01 for the full review window, including parent process, command line, and user.
Review WS-KORTEGA-01 logon and endpoint telemetry, including session details and activity associated with the 14:15 UTC logon.
Correlate PROXY-LV-01 connection and authentication telemetry around 13:40–14:16 UTC to determine whether it originated or relayed the traffic.
Verify with IT whether the 14:15 logon was authorized and review the relevant change or support records.
Collect execution, network, and file-access evidence for Google Drive File Stream on WS-DWELLS-01 to determine whether it was used.
